message: Install root path contains cmd-special characters (& % ^ ! ( ) ') or non-ASCII characters; tools such as batch wrappers, Node.js AI CLIs, or PowerShell may misbehave.
remedy: Move Engram to a clean ASCII path without special characters (e.g. C:\Engram).

message: Console/system code page is not UTF-8 (e.g. 949); non-ASCII output may be garbled. PYTHONUTF8 is set by Engram for its own processes.
remedy: Run 'chcp 65001' or enable Windows system-wide UTF-8 support.

message: Install path is inside a cloud-sync folder (OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive); sync and antivirus locks may cause backup, restore, or reset to fail closed on locked files.
remedy: Move Engram outside synced folders (e.g. C:\Engram).

message: Install path length is near MAX_PATH (260 characters); nested tool and package paths may exceed Windows limits.
remedy: Move Engram closer to the drive root (e.g. C:\Engram).
